Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were
involved in on a roadway in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just go by my initials for this, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me, in your own words, what happened?
A: I was driving along a two-lane road, going maybe thirty miles an hour. A car coming the other way drifted into my
lane. I braked and turned a little, but we still hit front to front. It wasn't a big impact, but it was enough to jolt me.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt at the time?
A: Yes, I was buckled in.
Q: Did your airbags deploy?
A: No, they didn't. My car just stopped pretty hard, and my head snapped forward and then back.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene, or did you stay inside?
A: I got out after a minute. I felt a little dizzy and my neck was already stiff.
Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They said I had whiplash and gave me a neck brace and
some pain medication.
Q: Are you sitll experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes. My neck is sore when I turn my head, and I get headaches most evenings. I've had to take time off from my
physical therapy job because lifting hurts.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add?
A: Just that I want my car repaired and my medical bills looked at. I've been cooperating and I want this handled
fairly.
Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
</page>

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
